blocks.text: This Michael Kors Ritz watch gets a glamorous look thanks to the subtle glassstone pavements and a stylish rose gold look

items.label: SPARKLING STATEMENT
items.value: This Michael Kors watch women will love features a pavé crystal topring and crystal-accented indexes that add a feminine touch; a classic three-link bracelet with pavé crystal center links and textured dial completes this watch

items.label: CASE & DIAL
items.value: Michael Kors watches for women with a 37mm stainless steel case and a rose dial; mineral crystal face resists scratches

items.label: WRIST WATCH BAND
items.value: Two-tone stainless steel bracelet band; 18mm band width; links can be removed for a customized fit

items.label: MOVEMENT
items.value: This rose gold watch for women has a quartz movement with chronograph analog watch display and date window; three subdials to track minutes, seconds, and 24-hour time; stopwatch functionality; imported

items.label: WATER RESISTANT LADIES WATCH
items.value: Up to 50m (165ft): Wearable while swimming in shallow water; 5 ATM
